notes: Values are approximate agronomic ranges, not authoritative local measurements.
Economic values (yield, price) are rough India-context estimates and REQUIRE local validation.
Market prices based on approximate MSP 2024-25 / mandi rates; do NOT treat as current.
Months are 1-12. Windows are [start_month, end_month] inclusive.
Unknown/unverified properties should be added as null, not fabricated.
Yield units are kg/ha — for fodder/vegetable/rhizome crops the value represents fresh (not dry/grain) biomass unless noted.
Several crops (jute, castor, ragi, jowar, etc.) are NOT major Punjab crops; agronomic ranges are pan-India.

rice.name: Rice (Paddy)
notes: Requires standing water during most of growing period
MSP procurement available — market risk low

wheat.name: Wheat
notes: MSP procurement — market risk low
Straw (bhusa) used as fodder locally

maize.name: Maize
notes: Grown in both kharif and rabi
High residue biomass — good for soil organic matter

chickpea.name: Chickpea (Gram)
notes: Tolerates alkaline soils
Mostly rainfed — 1-2 supplemental irrigations

mung_bean.name: Mung Bean (Green Gram)
notes: Short duration — fits between major crops
Good catch crop for summer window

mustard.name: Mustard (Rapeseed)
notes: Drought-tolerant rabi crop
Breaks poaceae-fabaceae cycle — adds family diversity

berseem.name: Berseem (Egyptian Clover)
notes: Multi-cut forage (4-6 cuts Nov-Apr)
Excellent N-fixer; forage markets thin — mostly on-farm use
Yield value is green fodder, not grain

cowpea.name: Cowpea
notes: Drought-tolerant legume
Dual purpose: grain and fodder

sorghum.name: Sorghum (Jowar)
notes: Drought-tolerant cereal — deep root system
Dual-purpose: grain and fodder (sweet sorghum for fodder)
Not a major Punjab crop — Maharashtra/Karnataka/MP dominant

pearl_millet.name: Pearl Millet (Bajra)
notes: High heat tolerance — thrives in arid/semi-arid regions
Deep taproot accesses subsoil moisture
Major in Rajasthan/Gujarat/Haryana; minor in Punjab

finger_millet.name: Finger Millet (Ragi)
notes: High calcium and micronutrient content
Predominantly rainfed crop
Not grown in Punjab — Karnataka/Tamil Nadu/Andhra dominant

foxtail_millet.name: Foxtail Millet (Kangni)
notes: Short-duration, drought-tolerant millet
Niche market — grown in southern/central India
Limited Punjab relevance

proso_millet.name: Proso Millet (Cheena)
notes: Very short duration — matures in 60-90 days
Drought-tolerant; grown on marginal soils
Limited Punjab relevance

barley.name: Barley (Jau)
notes: More drought/salt tolerant than wheat
Used for malt, feed and food
Grown in Rajasthan/UP/Haryana; minor in Punjab

pigeon_pea.name: Pigeon Pea (Arhar / Tur)
notes: Deep taproot tolerates drought once established
Long duration — intercropped with sorghum/soybean commonly
Major states: Maharashtra/MP/Karnataka/UP; marginal in Punjab

urad_bean.name: Black Gram (Urad)
notes: Short-duration pulse — fits rice-fallow system
Sticky nature of dough preferred for idli/dosa batter

lentil.name: Lentil (Masur)
notes: Cool-season rabi pulse
Major states: UP/MP/Bihar/WB; minor in Punjab

field_pea.name: Field Pea (Matar)
notes: Cool-season pulse — frost tolerant
Used as dry grain, vegetable pea, and fodder
UP/MP/Rajasthan dominant

soybean.name: Soybean
notes: Major oilseed + protein crop
Sensitive to waterlogging
Madhya Pradesh/Maharashtra/Rajasthan dominant; very minor in Punjab

horse_gram.name: Horse Gram (Kulthi)
notes: Hardiest pulse — thrives on poor soils and low rainfall
Used as fodder for cattle
South Indian states dominant; not grown in Punjab

moth_bean.name: Moth Bean (Matki)
notes: Excellent drought resistance — spreads as ground cover
Rajasthan dominant crop; not grown in Punjab

lathyrus.name: Lathyrus (Khesari)
notes: Grown on residual moisture after rice in lowlands
Contains neurotoxin ODAP — low-toxin varieties now mandated
Bihar/MP/WB dominant; not a Punjab crop

groundnut.name: Groundnut (Peanut)
notes: Major oilseed + fodder crop
Pods develop underground (geocarpy)
Gujarat/AP/Rajasthan/TN dominant; minor in Punjab

sesame.name: Sesame (Til)
notes: Called the 'queen of oilseeds'
Capsules shatter when over-ripe — timely harvest critical
Gujarat/WB/UP/Rajasthan dominant; not grown in Punjab

linseed.name: Linseed (Alsi)
notes: Cool-season rabi oilseed + fibre crop
MP/UP/Rajasthan dominant; not grown in Punjab

sunflower.name: Sunflower
notes: Spring/summer grown crop in north India
High-quality edible oil
Birds damage heads — needs scaring
Karnataka/Maharashtra/AP dominant; minor in Punjab

safflower.name: Safflower (Kusum)
notes: Drought-tolerant rabi oilseed with deep taproot
Flowers used for natural dye
Maharashtra/Karnataka dominant; not grown in Punjab

niger.name: Nigerseed (Ramtil)
notes: Grown on marginal/tribal lands in Kharif
Oil used for cooking + birdseed
MP/Orissa/Maharashtra dominant; not grown in Punjab

castor.name: Castor
notes: Industrial oilseed — non-edible
Indeterminate — multiple pickings needed
Gujarat/Rajasthan/Andhra dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

cotton.name: Cotton (Kapas)
notes: MSP procurement available for medium/long staple
Heavy pesticide use — Bt cotton widespread
Major cash crop in Punjab (Bathinda/Mansa/Ferozepur)

sugarcane.name: Sugarcane
notes: Long-duration perennial — ratoon crops common
Yield value is fresh cane weight
Major in UP/Maharashtra/Karnataka; Punjab grows ~90k ha

jute.name: Jute
notes: Fibre crop — retting in water required
MSP available for raw jute
West Bengal/Bihar/Assam dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

tobacco.name: Tobacco
notes: Cured leaf sold by grade
Labour-intensive crop — nursery, topping, curing
AP/Gujarat/Karnataka dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

oats.name: Oats (Fodder)
notes: Multi-cut winter fodder — 2-3 cuts
Yield value is green fodder
Punjab grows for dairy feed

guar.name: Cluster Bean (Guar)
notes: Guar gum (galactomannan) is high-value industrial product
Drought-tolerant Kharif legume
Rajasthan/Haryana/Gujarat dominant; minor in Punjab

sorghum_sudan_grass.name: Sorghum-Sudan Grass Hybrid
notes: Multi-cut summer fodder — fast regrowth
Yield value is green fodder
Prussic acid risk under drought/frost — manage accordingly

potato.name: Potato
notes: Cool-season tuber crop
Yield is fresh tuber weight
Major Punjab winter crop — UP/WB/Punjab/Bihar dominant

onion.name: Onion
notes: Yield is fresh bulb weight
Price highly volatile — 5-10x swings across seasons
Maharashtra/MP/Karnataka dominant; minor in Punjab

tomato.name: Tomato
notes: Yield is fresh fruit weight
Staking/hybrid cultivation boosts yields
Grown pan-India; AP/Karnataka/MP dominant

chilli.name: Chilli
notes: Yield and price refer to dry chilli
Multiple pickings — 6-8 harvests
AP/Telangana/Maharashtra/MP dominant; minor in Punjab

brinjal.name: Brinjal (Eggplant)
notes: Yield is fresh fruit weight
Most-produced vegetable in India after potato
Grown pan-India; WB/Orissa/Gujarat dominant

okra.name: Okra (Bhindi)
notes: Short-duration summer vegetable
Yield is fresh fruit weight
Grown pan-India

cabbage.name: Cabbage
notes: Cool-season cole crop
Yield is fresh head weight
Major in WB/Orissa/UP/Bihar; minor in Punjab

cauliflower.name: Cauliflower
notes: Cool-season cole crop — curd is harvested
Yield is fresh curd weight
Major in WB/Bihar/UP/Orissa; minor in Punjab

turmeric.name: Turmeric (Haldi)
notes: Yield is fresh rhizome weight; dry yield ~20% of fresh
Long-duration spice crop — 8-9 months
AP/TN/Maharashtra/Orissa dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

ginger.name: Ginger (Adrak)
notes: Yield is fresh rhizome weight; dry ginger ~20-25% of fresh
Needs shade/well-drained soil
Kerala/Karnataka/NE dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

coriander.name: Coriander (Dhania)
notes: Cool-season seed spice — leaves also used as vegetable
Rajasthan/Gujarat/MP dominant; minor in Punjab

cumin.name: Cumin (Jeera)
notes: Highly priced seed spice
Sensitive to frost and waterlogging
Rajasthan/Gujarat dominant; NOT grown in Punjab

fenugreek.name: Fenugreek (Methi)
notes: Dual purpose: leaves as vegetable + seeds as spice
Rajasthan/MP/Gujarat/UP dominant; minor in Punjab

fennel.name: Fennel (Saunf)
notes: Seed spice — fruits used
Gujarat/Rajasthan/UP dominant; NOT grown in Punjab
